intro: Three sisters from Israel who set Yemenite folk songs to beats.
story: A-WA are the sisters Tair, Liron and Tagel Haim, from the desert village of Shaharut in Israel, who sing Yemenite folk songs over hip-hop and reggae beats. Habib Galbi was the 2015 breakout single and the 2016 debut album on S-Curve, produced with Tomer Yosef of Balkan Beat Box, and they played Pickathon in 2017. Bayti Fi Rasi followed in 2019, and in December 2025 Tair Haim released her solo record Maktub.
artist_reel_line: Tair Haim put out her solo record Maktub in December 2025.

intro: A New Orleans band of soul, funk and spoken word.
story: Tank and the Bangas are a New Orleans band built around the singer Tarriona Tank Ball, blending hip hop, R&B, poetry and storytelling. In 2017 they won NPR's Tiny Desk Contest unanimously from more than 6,000 entries, and they came to Pickathon that year. They were nominated for Best New Artist at the 2020 Grammys, with Green Balloon in 2019 and Red Balloon in 2022. In fall 2026 they played club and theater dates, including Blue Note Los Angeles and Antone's in Austin.
artist_reel_line: In fall 2026 they toured clubs and theaters, including Blue Note Los Angeles.
